$description: ShopBase 2.0 Home (P01) semantic tokens, light mode only (frame lock). Every $value is an alias to 1-primitive.json; no raw values. Where the proof re-points a value on mobile (max-width 767px), a '-mobile' token holds the mobile value. Typography roles use the DTCG composite shape; letterSpacing is omitted where the proof sets none. NON-STANDARD types, kept on purpose: field.angle is typed dimension (DTCG has no angle type) and layout.split.* is typed string (not a DTCG type); see 1-primitive.json.

primary.$description: Get started buttons and the one approve control. Never a section background, field or body text.

muted.$description: Captions. Only on page, panel, F1, F2 (never on F3).

link.$description: Same colour as primary hover. Never on F3.

accent.$description: Accent tint: a found issue, a proposed fix, the approval highlight (title text on it; body, link and the field border also pass). Never muted text or the UI border color.border.default on it (palette: those only on page, panel, F1, F2 / page, panel, F1).

canvas.$description: PROOF ONLY: the grey canvas around the section frames. Not a page surface.

sky.$description: The logo's sky. Small markers; never text.

default.$description: UI outlines (3:1). On page, panel and F1 only.

field.$description: UI outline where the edge touches F1 or F2. Not on F3.

divider.$description: Decorative hairline; carries no UI meaning.

text.$description: Only a state the seller caused (approved).

angle.$description: Linear gradient angle for all three soft fields. Never on text.

section.$description: Vertical gap between sections; the top step, used nowhere else.

field-mobile.$description: Proof: --radius-field: var(--radius-card) inside the mobile block where --radius-card is also re-pointed to --radius-inner, so the computed value is 1rem. Rendered at 375 (headless Chrome, Step 19 review): field, card and inner card all have a 16px corner, so the 'inner smaller than parent' radius family does not hold on mobile. Token = what the proof renders; if a 1.5rem mobile field was meant, change it at Step 20/21.

card.$description: White card on a soft field. Inner cards use none.

device.$description: PROOF wrapper shadow; not part of the page.

paragraph.$description: Section paragraph text (the proof's .text-body). Same values as typography.lead because the proof's .text-body uses --size-lead (1.25rem), not --size-body (1rem). Named 'paragraph', not 'body', so it is not confused with the proof's --size-body, which maps to typography.base.

base.$description: Document base text and button label size (the proof's --size-body, 1rem). Not re-pointed on mobile.
Declared default (75rem). In the proof it never applies: the two media queries below cover every width.

compact.$description: Max content width at viewport max-width 1439px.

wide.$description: Max content width at viewport min-width 1440px.

frame-max.$description: PROOF wrapper width (the 1440 desktop frame). Not a decided page max width.

text.$description: Max width of lead and body text.

hero.$description: Max width of the hero headline.

min-width.$description: Minimum full-logo width (identity proposal) and the width shown in the proof legend.

clear-space-ratio.$description: Clear space = logo width x this ratio, all four sides.
